apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
# The admin plane (admin identity design §D1, unit 1.3): a separate process
# and Deployment from vuoro-control, reached only over the operator WireGuard
# tunnel. Runbook: docs/runbooks/admin-plane.md.
resources: [deployment.yaml, service.yaml, admin-enrol-cronjob.yaml]
configMapGenerator:
  # WebAuthn relying party for the admin listener. allowed_aaguids lists only
  # key models the operator has verified (FIDO MDS3 + the key's own getInfo);
  # any other key is refused, and the refusal names the presented AAGUID.
  # Today: 2fc0579f-8113-47ea-b116-bb5a8db9202a, YubiKey 5 Series with NFC.
  #
  # attestation_roots_pem, fetched 2026-09-27 from https://developers.yubico.com/PKI/:
  #   1. "Yubico Attestation Root 1"
  #      https://developers.yubico.com/PKI/yubico-fido-ca-1.pem
  #      SHA-256 62:76:0C:6A:6E:F9:16:79:F4:54:C8:90:2B:80:FD:00:98:25:B3:F2:5D:A9:0F:1F:BA:CE:2E:C6:58:6C:D5:A8
  #   2. "Yubico U2F Root CA Serial 457200631"
  #      https://developers.yubico.com/PKI/yubico-ca-1.pem
  #      SHA-256 0F:A1:38:6F:80:EB:87:13:26:3A:E5:C1:D8:4D:EB:45:5B:DF:08:AE:A5:0A:B0:55:03:CE:FE:E8:2B:09:2D:42
  # tests/test_admin_manifests.py recomputes both fingerprints.
  - name: vuoro-admin-webauthn
    namespace: vuoro-system
    files: [admin-webauthn.json]
